permissions.title: Claude permissions
permissions.modeHint: Applies to Claude tabs started or restarted afterwards. Shift+Tab still switches modes inside a tab.

modeHints.default: No flag is passed; Claude's own settings choose the mode.
modeHints.manual: Claude asks before editing files or running commands.
modeHints.acceptEdits: File edits and common file commands run without asking.
modeHints.plan: Claude researches and proposes a plan without changing files.
modeHints.auto: A classifier reviews actions instead of asking you. Needs a supported plan and model.
modeHints.dontAsk: Only pre-approved tools run; anything else is denied without asking.
modeHints.bypassPermissions: Every command and edit runs without asking. Use only in trusted projects.

permissions.allowBypass: Allow switching to bypass with Shift+Tab
permissions.allowBypassHint: Tabs start in the chosen mode, and bypass permissions joins the Shift+Tab cycle. While it is available, plan mode no longer blocks edits.
permissions.testQueueNote: The test queue keeps working in every mode, bypass included: its hook runs before Claude's permission check.
permissions.projectHint: Used by this project's Claude tabs unless a tab was opened in a specific mode.
permissions.newTabMenu: Open Claude in a specific mode
permissions.tabBypass: Started in bypass permissions mode: Claude runs commands and edits without asking.

confirm.title: Bypass permissions?
confirm.risk: In this mode Claude runs every command and file edit without asking you, including deleting files, installing packages and pushing to git.
confirm.trust: Use it only in projects you trust, ideally isolated ones. Content Claude reads (web pages, files, issues) can steer it, and no prompt stops a harmful step.
confirm.claude: Claude also shows its own warning in the terminal the first time. Your deny rules and ClaudeDeck's test queue still apply.
